text:
alex: alert from our storage scanner — found a GKE node SA that had broad write perms to a project GCS bucket (models-artifacts-prod).

maria: ouch. where did the scan pull the ACL from? service account binding vs bucket ACL?

alex: binding on project `roles/storage.objectAdmin` for `gke-node-sa@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. bucket didn't have CMEK enforced, objects were default-encrypted.

sam: is there evidence of exfil or objects created recently?

alex: listing shows a few objects with timestamps this morning 02:14-02:27 UTC. names look like `tmp-upload-<uuid>.tar`. size ~12MB each. no obvious public links.

rachel: first containment: remove the SA binding and revoke tokens. also enable object versioning & block public access on the bucket. I'll do RBAC change now.

rachel: running: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding infra-prod --member=serviceAccount:gke-node-sa@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectAdmin`

sec-bot: automated audit note: IAM binding removal recorded by CloudAudit at 2025-11-15T02:40:11Z. Logging export to sec-logs-bucket triggered.

omcall: @oncall stepping in to rotate any long-lived keys and force metadata/token refresh on nodes.

oncall: rolling restart of affected node pool (gke-prod-nodepool-2) queued, will cordon + drain then restart. ETA ~25m.

maria: we need to check KMS usage. bucket lacked CMEK force; objects encrypted with Google-managed keys. need to decide if we rotate to CMEK and re-encrypt.

sam: short term: snapshot/delete suspicious objects and snapshot their audit trails. long term: enforce CMEK + bucket policy.

alex: snapshotting object list and copies to `sec-artifacts-prod/quarantine/1767890123/` using gsutil cp. command run:```
gsutil cp gs://models-artifacts-prod/tmp-upload-* gs://sec-artifacts-prod/quarantine/1767890123/```

rachel: revoked SA tokens: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=gke-node-sa@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID` for each.

sec-bot: detection: possible misuse window ~02:14-02:27 UTC. No external IPs detected in VPC flow logs to S3 endpoints.

maria: next actions for containment completed: 1) removed storage.objectAdmin from node SA 2) cordon+drain+restart node pool 3) copied suspicious objects to quarantine 4) exported audit logs to sec-logs-bucket.

alex: forensics: running `gcloud logging read` queries to pull auth/iam logs for SA activity and `gcloud asset search-all-resources` for recent iamPolicyChanges.

sam: regarding KMS: propose to create CMEK key ring `infra-prod-keys/redis`? actually `infra-prod-keys/gcs-assets` and set bucket defaultKey. Also add IAM condition: only storage.* from trusted services.

maria: Agree. Also add org policy to require CMEK for storage buckets in prod projects. I'll open a policy PR.

rachel: communication: drafting an internal incident note for SRE/Platform and CSB. nothing externally customer-facing for now.

oncall: quick vuln triage: how did node SA get that role? need terraform review. maybe a TF module allowed `iam_binding` on project scope for node SAs.

alex: found terraform change in infra repo — commit 8f3a2 added `roles/storage.objectAdmin` to `${var.node_sa}` via a legacy module. author @devops-oleg.

sam: rollback PR opened: revert that binding and update module to use least-priv. assign to @devops-oleg, tag `high-priority`.

maria: post-incident tasks: 1) enforce least privilege in TF modules 2) org policy for CMEK 3) enable bucket-level lock for public access 4) schedule KMS enablement + re-encrypt job 5) add test in CI to detect project-scoped objectAdmin grants.

rachel: security runbook update: add a step to require `storage.admin` approvals and to alert on project-level objectAdmin bindings.

sec-bot: automated vuln ticket created: SEC-2025-431 — "Project-level storage permissions granted to node SA". Assigned to devops. Link: https://tracker.internal/SEC-2025-431

alex: final note — no evidence of data exfil so far; proceed with rotation & hardening. will keep thread updated if logs show unusual outbound. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone. we'll schedule a quick postmortem tomorrow 16:00 UTC. action owners in ticket.

rachel: closing containment tasks in incident tracker, leaving postmortem & remediation open.

deploy-bot: deploy status: terraform revert PR merged to `main` at 2025-11-15T04:12:42Z. CI passed.

sec-bot: incident update logged. next update in channel after postmortem.
